title: Custody store reader for evidence.py; decouple the S2 suite from the live custody.store value
objective: Give evidence.py a read-only reader for the live custody registry (amendment v1.0.2) so custody can be evaluated at T020, and make the S2 tests independent of the contract's live custody.store value.
problem: AMENDMENT_v1.0.2.md sets custody.store to postgresql://192.168.1.202:5432/prometheus_fire#custody.registry (Aporia #1353). evidence.py raises STORE_UNREACHABLE for any set locator (declared T014 escape: no reader), and test_unset_store_is_keeper_row_missing reads the live contract value, so applying the field turns the suite red. The real T020 run needs custody read from the store: rows via `python -m ops.custody.registry read --json` semantics (or its Python API), the chain checked via verify (exit 1 -> custody FAIL ROW_CHAIN_BROKEN, exit 3 -> STORE_UNREACHABLE), and B5.3's QUALIFIED conditions evaluated on fetched rows (consumer fetches itself; row registered before the consumer's first check; row blob equals the committed blob).
non_goals: No write path: the reader never writes the registry (Aporia only)
No change to B5.3 semantics or the why codes (V6 format)
No network or DB access in unit tests: tests use a stub reader; one optional live smoke test is skipped unless an env var is set
evidence_required: RED: a test that a set locator with a stub reader returning registered rows yields custody QUALIFIED, failing before the reader exists
a test that the chain-broken stub yields FAIL ROW_CHAIN_BROKEN and unreachable yields STORE_UNREACHABLE (never a pass)
test_unset_store_is_keeper_row_missing rewritten to use a fixture custody dict, not the live contract
contract.json custody fields updated exactly as AMENDMENT_v1.0.2.md W1/W2 and version 1.0.2, manifest rewritten, full suite green in the same commit

acceptance.command: python -B -m rso.slice001.ci && python -m comms.manifest verify rso/slice001/contract
acceptance.condition: suite green with contract.json at 1.0.2 and custody.store set; stub-reader QUALIFIED/ROW_CHAIN_BROKEN/STORE_UNREACHABLE cases pass
